Process

How We Deliver

Kodex Designs believes in transparency every step of the way, keeping you in the loop with every executed plan.

Discovery

We get to know your brand, your goals, and the audience you intend to reach through conversations and discovery calls.

Strategy & Planning

We draft a tailored action plan with clear deliverables, timelines, KPIs, and the tools and platforms we will use.

Design & Build

Our team sets the plan in motion, and you are updated on progress at every stage of the build.

Launch & Support

We make every necessary retouch before launch. Only when you are satisfied do we go live — then we stay on for ongoing improvements.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What technologies do you build with?

We use cutting-edge, well-supported technologies chosen to fit the project — from front-end frameworks through to the back-end and hosting stack.

Can you work with our existing site?

Yes. We regularly take over, audit and extend existing codebases as well as building from scratch.

Do you provide ongoing maintenance?

We do. Our maintenance service keeps your site current, secure, and running at its optimal level after launch.

Will we own the code?

Yes. On completion the codebase is yours, handed over with documentation.

Ready to Build Something That Lasts?

Tell us what you need it to do, and we will tell you how we would build it.
